neighbours.label: a modifier or quantifier right before the nested sub-items of a hierarchy ("all immediate subdirectories", "several inline elements"); output promotes ' child'/' sub'
fire: The script walks the folder and lists its immediate subfolders one by one.
In XML, every element may contain several nested child elements of its own.
The method deletes the node together with all of its descendants in the tree.
A block-level tag can wrap multiple inline spans inside the paragraph.
Call the helper to collect every direct child widget of the main window.
The scanner then extends its queue with each subdirectory found under the root.
Each category page shows a list of its sub-categories below the title.
The parser recursively visits the immediate children of the current node.
quiet: The script walks the folder and prints its total size in megabytes.
In XML, every element may contain a single attribute named id.
The method deletes the node and then logs the time it took.
A block-level tag can start a new line inside the paragraph.
Call the helper to collect every error message from the main window.
The scanner then extends its timeout whenever the network is slow.
Each category page shows a short description below the title.
The parser recursively checks the syntax of the current file.

notes: card: top peaks ' immediate', ' all', ' a', ' of' before subdirs/children/references in code; logit promotes child/sub. Probe: ' immediate' 0.50, ' several' 0.35, 'child nodes' only 0.14.
